name: pentagi
description: Fully autonomous AI Agents system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks
one_liner: A self-hosted system of AI agents that can automatically run authorized security tests against a company's own systems and produce a professional vulnerability report.
buyer: A mid-sized company's internal security team that wants to run frequent, low-cost automated penetration tests between the expensive annual audits they already pay outside firms for.
business_use_cases: An internal security team runs it continuously in a sandboxed environment to catch new vulnerabilities between scheduled third-party pentests.
A boutique cybersecurity consultancy uses it to accelerate the reconnaissance and reporting phase of client engagements, taking on more clients with the same headcount.
A managed security service provider (MSSP) offers 'continuous automated pentesting' as a new subscription tier for small-business clients who can't afford full manual pentests.

money_ideas.idea: Launch an MSSP-style 'continuous automated pentesting' subscription for small and mid-sized businesses built on top of it.
Offer paid deployment, hardening, and monitoring setup services for security teams who want to run it safely in production.

steal_this: Package it as a monthly 'automated pentest health check' subscription for small businesses that can't afford traditional manual pentest firms, with a human reviewing the AI's findings before delivery.
